subject: llply assign TRUE or FALSE to list

messages.author: c102ef7f5617067f
messages.subject: llply assign TRUE or FALSE to list
parts:
I have a list like this:

myList <- list(seq(0, 50, 10), seq(0, 50, 10), seq(0, 50, 10), seq(0, 50, 10), seq(0, 50, 10))

I need: 

myListNeeded <- list(c(rep(NA, 5), 6:10), c(rep(NA, 5), 6:10), c(rep(NA, 5), 6:10), c(rep(NA, 5), 6:10), c(rep(NA, 5), 6:10))

Is there a way of doing this with llply?

messages.subject: Re: llply assign TRUE or FALSE to list
parts:
Like Ista, I have no idea why you'd want to do this, but here ya go....

library(plyr)
myList <- replicate(5, list(u))
g <- function(x) c(rep(NA, length(x)), 5 + x/10)
llply(myList, g)

Dennis
